name: Etoiles Terre
original_name: エトワール・テーレー
source:
Has lost his mother in the past because of a "star hunting". From the experience of being a son of a "witch", he wished to eliminate "star hunting" due to death of his mother, so he became a lawyer of Astrologers.

[spoiler]Witch of Orion Constellation.[/spoiler]
